name: Inaho Shin
source: Master of the seaside cafe "YuKuRu" and the father of two daughters. He runs the café with his daughter, [url=/c97438] Rin[/url]. A family-man at heart; he prioritizes his wife and daughters above all else. Experienced with managing a café, [url=/c96372] Chihaya[/url] seeks his advice in hopes of opening her own. He has a record player that plays nostalgic tunes.
